scope: One host, one API process, one worker. Proves the mechanisms work; proves nothing about capacity, multi-replica fan-out, or behaviour under load. The redis outage is a container pause, not a network partition. Cross-tenant checks exercise header handling against a single-tenant estate, which is weaker than two provisioned tenants with data.
